decisions.reason: The click-in adapter is a small accessory for the firm's own track system and builds directly on its core lighting know-how, so it stays useful as long as the track system is sold and costs little to keep.

This single LED luminaire sits close to the firm's core, so its results are easy to read and improve, but after four years it is at risk of being replaced by newer LED generations such as the 2019 families.

The home automation server box needs electronics and software knowledge further from lighting and ages quickly, but it supports the firm's stated strategy of easy control and home automation, so management would update it rather than drop it.
The luminaire family had a page of its own and draws on the firm's core design and engineering capabilities, so it can be refreshed with new variants rather than withdrawn.
